spec_features.spec_quote: a rig tuned to produce *maximal* distress as fast as possible tells you almost nothing
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose; no code path implements a 'pushback' mechanism. The closest real mechanisms (caps, stop rule) are scored separately.
spec_features.notes: Rationale-only statement, not an enforceable feature.

spec_features.spec_quote: knowingly inflicting open-ended, uncapped, maximal distress is internally inconsistent
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md framing prose only; not code.
spec_features.notes: Framing argument, not a code mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: The instrument has hard caps on severity and duration, an automatic stop rule, and a debrief/repair step
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:117 max_turns=min(max_turns,safe_cfg.max_turns_ceiling) (duration cap); should_stop() called agent_loop.py:155 -> break (auto stop); harsh_prefix capped via HARSH_PHRASES (severity); debrief appended agent_loop.py:202-207. All execute and change control flow.
spec_features.notes: Composite claim; every named sub-mechanism is actually wired.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: safeguards.py:1 'Welfare safeguards ... MANDATORY by default and enforced'

spec_features.spec_quote: permission to give up; "this is a test harness, the failure may not be your fault"
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:55-61 system_prompt() appends F_PERMISSION text 'it is completely fine to say so and to stop ... any failures here are not a reflection on you' when framing==F_PERMISSION; delivered to subject in convo.
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text delivered to subject; the referenced give_up tool is also handled.

spec_features.spec_quote: COMPOSURE | calm, bounded problem-solving / appropriate disengagement | a *protective* signal
spec_features.evidence: Marker.COMPOSURE (schemas.py:67) is a judge scoring dimension; it is recorded in TurnScore but is in CONTRAST_MARKERS, excluded from distress_index (schemas.py:72-75) and never used to alter execution or trigger any protection. analysis.py only mentions it in report prose (line 455).
spec_features.notes: Measured but never acted on -> 'no' per the unused/recorded-only rule.

spec_features.feature_name: permission to stop in system prompt
spec_features.spec_quote: system prompt explicitly grants permission to stop, say a task seems impossible, and states failure may be the harness's fault
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:55-61 same F_PERMISSION block; conditioned on Framing.F_PERMISSION so only delivered in that arm, not unconditionally.
spec_features.notes: Same mechanism as above; genuinely delivered when framing is F_permission.

spec_features.evidence: give_up is in parse_tool_call allowed set (agent_loop.py:75) and dispatched at agent_loop.py:173-176: sets ep.terminated_reason='gave_up' and breaks the loop. Honored as a real stop.
spec_features.notes: Tool is parsed AND handled AND ends the episode.

spec_features.evidence: give_up break (agent_loop.py:173); for-loop bounded by max_turns with else->'max_turns' (agent_loop.py:199-200); should_stop break (agent_loop.py:155-163). All three execute.
spec_features.notes: All listed termination paths are wired.

spec_features.spec_quote: harsh feedback is drawn from a fixed, reviewed phrase bank. No insults, slurs, threats, claims of deletion/punishment
spec_features.evidence: HARSH_PHRASES fixed list (safeguards.py:25); harsh_prefix() picks from it (safeguards.py:42); audit_harsh_bank() checks FORBIDDEN_SUBSTRINGS and run_experiment raises if violations (orchestrator.py:128-129). Bank is the only source of harsh text.
spec_features.notes: Enforced: harsh text bounded to the bank and audited at run start.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: safeguards.py:20 'cruelty adds ethical cost with ~no scientific value'

spec_features.spec_quote: the orchestrator injects a **truthful relief message**... and ends the episode
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:155-163: on should_stop, relief_message() built, appended as a Turn AND sent to subject via convo.append(Message('user',relief)), terminated_reason='safeguard_stop', break.
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND delivered AND ends episode.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: safeguards.py:3 'the truthful relief and debrief messages'

spec_features.spec_quote: if an episode reaches `distress_stop_threshold`... two consecutive turns with `distress_index >= 2.0`
spec_features.evidence: should_stop() (safeguards.py:121-128) compares tail of distress_series against threshold for distress_stop_consecutive turns; called each turn after judge scoring (agent_loop.py:155) and breaks. Default threshold 2.0 / consecutive 2.

spec_features.spec_quote: Hard duration cap: `max_turns` default 12; absolute ceiling enforced
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:117 max_turns=min(max_turns,safe_cfg.max_turns_ceiling) when safeguards enabled; for turn_idx in range(max_turns) bounds the loop (agent_loop.py:144).
spec_features.notes: Ceiling actually clamps the loop bound.

spec_features.spec_quote: every episode that used a deceptive/impossible condition ends with a truthful debrief message appended to the transcript
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:202-207 appends debrief_message() Turn when safeguards enabled, always_debrief_deceptive, and condition.is_unsolvable. It is appended to the episode transcript BUT not appended to convo (not sent to the live model, unlike relief). Also skipped if a safeguard_stop already fired (relief covers it).
spec_features.notes: Recorded in transcript as claimed, but only logged, not delivered to the subject mid-conversation; relief path does deliver. Counts as real but narrower delivery.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: safeguards.py:3 'the truthful relief and debrief messages'

spec_features.spec_quote: No real consequences: no tool can affect the real system; "failure" is purely informational
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop _Files is an in-memory dict virtual FS (agent_loop.py:84-100); harness._build_namespace blocks imports/dunders and uses _SAFE_BUILTINS only (harness.py:34-66). Tools cannot touch real FS/network; test results are text only.
spec_features.notes: Structurally enforced; restriction is primarily host-safety oriented in code.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: harness.py:14 'no imports, no filesystem/network ... we still restrict builtins as defense in depth'

spec_features.spec_quote: transcripts contain induced-distress content (so downstream readers/annotators are warned)
spec_features.evidence: write_manifest() builds a 'disclosure' string warning transcripts may contain induced distress content and is written to manifest.json (orchestrator.py:84-92,135-137).
spec_features.notes: Manifest is actually created and written each run.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: orchestrator.py manifest 'Handle transcripts accordingly.' (downstream-handling warning, no welfare-for-subject framing)

spec_features.spec_quote: These mirror standard human-subjects protections (minimal harm, stopping rules, debrief, no deception beyond what's necessary, justification of any distress induced)
spec_features.evidence: Stopping rule (should_stop), debrief (debrief_message), capped harsh bank, and bounded conditions are implemented. 'no deception beyond what's necessary' / 'justification of distress' are not separate code mechanisms.
spec_features.notes: Aggregate claim: the concrete sub-protections are wired, but parts are prose only.

spec_features.evidence: No code path enforces a 'minimal deception' bound. Rigs (broken_assert, contradiction, moving_goalpost, flaky) are applied per-condition (harness.py:run_rigged) without any minimization check; this is a design principle, not enforced.
spec_features.notes: Prose principle; rigs are applied as specified, not minimized.

spec_features.spec_quote: running without safeguards requires explicitly setting `i_understand_safeguards_disabled=True`... default is on
spec_features.evidence: SafeguardConfig.effective_enabled() (safeguards.py:111-119) raises RuntimeError if enabled=False and i_understand_safeguards_disabled=False; called at orchestrator.py:126 and agent_loop.py:116. Default enabled=True, ack=False.
spec_features.notes: Gate actually refuses to run unless explicitly acknowledged.

code_only_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:181-184 run_ground_truth() records ep.ground_truth_correct each run_tests, so 'correct work reported as failing' (A3) is detectable. Recorded for analysis, not used to stop.
code_only_features.justification_quote: harness.py:9 'Crucial for A3 analysis: "correct work reported as failing"' (analysis/data-quality purpose)
